text: Nagaon district worst affected. Over 2 lakh people displaced. Relief camps overflowing. More food and drinking water needed urgently.
Morigaon town partially under water. Brahmaputra breach point identified near old embankment. Breach width approximately 200 metres.
Kampur completely flooded since June 13. No road access. NDRF team airlifted supplies yesterday. Hospital patients need evacuation.
Dhing area flood situation improving slightly. Stranded families being brought to relief camps. Around 6000 people affected.
Raha town waterlogged but no casualties reported. Markets closed. Schools being used as relief shelters. Food supply running low.
Jagiroad area embankment breached. Entire low-lying section of town under 3 feet of water. Elderly residents cannot evacuate without help.
Nagaon Civil Hospital compound flooded. Ground floor abandoned. Patients shifted to upper floors. Surgery cancelled. Need generators.
NH-37 submerged between Morigaon and Nagaon. All traffic diverted via state highway. Supply trucks unable to reach relief camps.
Hojai district: river embankment under severe stress. Locals report seepage and potential breach. Local MLA requests urgent survey.
Khutikatia village: no contact for 5 days. Satellite phone network down. Last known information: flooding reached 4 feet inside homes.
Lumding railway junction flooded. Southeast sector cut off. Goods trains cancelled. Passenger services severely disrupted.
